recentItems.title: Marvel's Wolverine - All 32 Suits Showcase in 4K
recentItems.description:
Wolverine's been around for quite a while, both canonically and in real life. As such, he's sported a ton of different looks over the years, most of which are represented as unlockable costumes in Marvel's Wolverine. So if you wanna get a quick look at each suit in action, see how it looks clean, and while covered in blood, here's a showcase covering all 32 outfits, costumes, and suits, in Marvel's Wolverine.

recentItems.title: Marvel's Wolverine: All Material Crates Locations
recentItems.description:
Material Crates in Marvel’s Wolverine come in various shapes and sizes, but they all have one thing in common: they give you materials when you open them. Gather enough, and you can purchase alternate costumes for Wolverine that are inspired by all sorts of comic events from Logan's lifetime. If you want to track down every Material Crate so you can unlock every suit, this guide is for you.

recentItems.title: Diablo 5 To Launch With More Classes Than Any Other in the Franchise | Blizzcon 2026
recentItems.description:
We sat down with the development team for Diablo 5 to discuss what to expect when the game launches in 2029. In this video, we chat with Blizzard about how Diablo 5 will affect the ongoing development for Diablo 4, how the itemization is Diablo 5 seeks to return to franchise roots, and how Diablo taking the center stage affects the moment-to-moment of Diablo 5 gameplay.

#ign #gaming

recentItems.title: Diablo 4 - Official Season of Hell's Legacy Gameplay Trailer
recentItems.description:
Take a look at the Season of Hell's Legacy Gameplay Trailer for Diablo 4 and relive iconic battles or dive into waking nightmares. Diablo IV: Season of Hell's Legacy begins September 15.

#ign #gaming

recentItems.title: Diablo 4 Has No Signs of Slowing Down Despite Diablo 5 - Blizzcon 2026
recentItems.description:
We sat down with the creative director and sesaons lead for Diablo 4 to catch up on all the news that was announced for the game during Blizzcon 2026. Even though Diablo 5 is on the horizon, the developers behind Diablo 4 have assured they have no intentions on slowing down updates for the game. With Diable 4 Season 15: Hell's Legacy right around the corner, and the much requested Amazon Class looming not too far off, Blizzard aims to prove Diablo 4 has a lot of life left to give. 

#ign #gaming

recentItems.title: New StarCraft Gameplay Details & a Promised Release Date
recentItems.description:
After all these years, Blizzard is finally ready to bring us a new StarCraft game... in 2030. But history shows that Blizzard can be a bit lose with their release dates, especially ones that are so far out. However, creative director Dan Hay is very confident that StarCraft will indeed release on time in 2030. Plus, we hear about how the game is shaping and god teases of what we can expect the game might play like. 

#ign #gaming #StarCraft

recentItems.title: World of Warcraft - Official Talebound Story Trailer
recentItems.description:
Check out the Talebound Story trailer for World of Warcraft, the legendary MMO RPG developed by Blizzard Entertainment. As Midnight approaches in Azeroth, Talebound looms. Take your place in Quillgrave and survive the night. Make it through this new special game mode, and you just may earn rewards untold. May you find riches in Talebound, good Champion. Talebound is coming soon.

#ign #gaming

recentItems.title: Diablo Himself Returns in Diablo 4 | Season 15 Gameplay
recentItems.description:
You don't have to wait until Diablo 5 and its 2029 release date to face off against Diablo, the Lord of Terror. Instead, Diablo 4's Season 15 seeks to inject a bit of nostalgia by bringing all three prime evils together in a sort of boss rush mode. Take a trip down memory lane as Deckard Cain makes a surprise comeback to talk Diablo lore as you descened through hell to face off against Diablo.

#ign #gaming

recentItems.title: Alkimya: House of Wisdom - Official Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the Alkimya: House of Wisdom announcement trailer for this upcoming first-person survival horror game set in the House of Wisdom during the 1258 siege of Baghdad. Scavenge for resources, craft alchemical flasks, unlock an interconnected sanctum of Golden Age puzzles, and survive the Mongol invaders — and the cosmic horror waiting beneath them. Alkimya: House of Wisdom will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) and PlayStation.

recentItems.title: World of Warcraft: Forever - Official Gameplay Trailer | BlizzCon 2026
recentItems.description:
Discover the secrets of Azeroth’s newest playable race, harness powers yet unseen, and take new first steps through lands untrodden when World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, 2026. Or, uncover Azeroth’s mysteries early by playing in the WoW: Forever Beta starting September 17, 2026, when you pre-purchase the Skyborne Epic Pack or the Warcraft Forever Collection.

#ign #gaming
